# scamp_network (Data Source)

Retrieves information about an existing network by UUID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of the network to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `cidr` (String) CIDR block of the network.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the network was created.
- `name` (String) Name of the network.
- `network_type` (String) Type of network: 'private' or 'public'.
- `router_uuid` (String) UUID of the attached router, if any.
- `status` (String) Current status of the network.
